changelog.summary: Registered the Claude Design Inventory revision batch 4 (67 screens, five grouped pages, index, seven print variants, support.js, doc-page.js and the revision manifest; the design's TRACEABILITY-v2.md is not registered) as an unapproved visual candidate. Earlier exports (first export, v2, v2 batch 3) are preserved in Incoming/ and are not registered. Status review-ready; no owner visual approval.

notes: Unapproved Inventory visual candidate, batch 4 revision of 67 screens (UI-INV-001..006 and the Inventory behaviour required by FR-INV). The earlier note that an approved Inventory source existed in Claude Design is historical and does not approve the bytes registered here. The source cites no FR-INV, BR-INV or UI-INV identifier on any screen and its TRACEABILITY-v2.md does not match the screens; requirement coverage is established by the integration traceability (traceability.json), not by the design. Known open defects include clipped tables at the supported viewports, incomplete accessibility structure and inert controls. No stock-ledger rule, costing, permission, API or decision is invented; unresolved items stay OPEN. The package ships the real support.js (byte-identical to the accepted copies) and doc-page.js for the seven print variants. It is NOT an approved visual reference; owner visual approval has not been given.
